## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and any compatibility or migration impact.

## Evidence

List the relevant checks and their results. State what remains unqualified.
For administration, include the operation IDs and exact upstream source revision.

## Release impact

State patch (default), minor, major, or none. Explain any compatibility break.
Confirm that explanatory docs and deterministic output match the changed sources.
Do not include credentials, prompts, private endpoints, or raw host diagnostics.
